highlights: Cloud and download status now updates only the affected song rows and album cards instead of rebuilding the entire library view.
Play counts, favorites, file repairs, playlist totals, and home listening widgets now refresh in place.
Settings controls and sidebar playlists avoid unnecessary redraws for a smoother, more stable interface.
notes: Introduces keyed, targeted UI refreshes throughout the desktop app while retaining full view rebuilds only for structural library changes.
